## Load libraries

```{r}
#| message: false

library("tidyverse")
library("here")
```

## Raw Data Loading

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

data_url <- "https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1b7DHLNFZ94zUnACNLonrgjN9fYtrdmOV"
zip_file <- here("data/_raw/data.zip")

# download zipped folder
download.file(url = data_url, 
              destfile = zip_file, 
              mode = "wb")

# extract files from zipped folder
measles_raw   <- read_csv(unz(zip_file, "measles_vaccine.csv"))
mortality_raw <- read_csv(unz(zip_file, "under_5_mortality_rate.csv"))
stunting_raw  <- read_csv(unz(zip_file, "stunting_prevalence.csv"))
```

## Store raw data in a dedicated folder

```{r}
write_tsv(x = mortality_raw, file = here("data/01_mortality_load.tsv"))
write_tsv(x = measles_raw, file = here("data/01_measles_load.tsv"))
write_tsv(x = stunting_raw, file = here("data/01_stunting_load.tsv"))
```
